provenance.paper_title: ReflectCAP: Detailed Image Captioning with Reflective Memory

representation_paths.memory_component: Structured Reflection Notes: Avoid Notes for recurring hallucinations and Include Notes for frequently omitted details

evidence.paraphrase: A Captioning Agent captions exemplar images zero-shot, a Feedback Agent critiques each caption against the image and a human reference, and a Note Organizer merges recurring issues into at most K Avoid and K Include rules.
At inference each note category is injected whole into its own captioning call (Avoid Notes for a grounded caption, Include Notes for a detailed one), and a third call merges the two captions.

adjudication_notes: Community submission (corpus issue #8), reviewed against arXiv HTML v1.

Tier T1: notes are distilled offline from a small exemplar set and then reused unchanged for every test image (Sec. 3.2: 'Once constructed, the Structured Reflection Notes replace the multi-agent pipeline entirely'); Algorithm 2 has no note-revision step. Merging, abstraction, and the K-item cap happen only during offline construction, so they are not counted as inference-time T2 operations.
In scope through formation: the stored memory is text, but the Feedback Agent critiques each caption against the image, so a non-text modality contributes to forming the memory.
Retrieval coded as metadata-keyed because each note category is selected by type and injected in full; there is no similarity search.
